title: Enjoying this!
text: We are really enjoying this so far. We've been in the club since Sept 2018 now for our five year old..  We have got, so far, the Cars car you put together (Lightning McQueen) which was a bit hard for him to do - he needed adult help.  The talking microscope is good although unless there are more slides it has a limited span of play.  I did cancel one month because the item had bad reviews, so I didn't want to try it - it was a gardening one.  Then Dec was a National Geographic crystal growing kit - which looks like it will be fun. We haven't done it yet. (Great deal as its normally $40 and we paid stem price of $19.99.)  I like being a part of this as it is always choosing things not on my radar at all - and I appreciate that. I love the whole STEM concept too, being so educational.  We will be continuing and recommend!
label: positive
